Z:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Crusader Kings III\game\localization\english\game_concepts_l_english.yml:702: game_concept_mercenary_company_desc:0 "[mercenaries|E] are [soldiers|E] for hire who fight in exchange for [gold|E]. Mercenary [armies|E] come in various sizes, with different types of [men_at_arms|E] and a number of [knights|E].

Mercenaries sign up for #V [GetDefine('NMercenary', 'BASE_HIRE_MONTHS')] month#! contracts that can be extended for another #V [GetDefine('NMercenary', 'BASE_HIRE_MONTHS')] months#! if you are still at [war|E]. Mercenary contracts persist even if their Regiments are dismissed — they can be raised again without further cost.

You are allowed to go into [debt|E] in order to hire Mercenaries #weak (up to [GetDefine('NMercenary', 'ALLOWED_DEBT_MONTHS')] months)#!."

Z:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Crusader Kings III\game\localization\english\game_concepts_l_english.yml:705: game_concept_mercenary_contract_desc:0 "Establishing a [mercenary|E] Contract incurs a one-time cost which allows the use of their troops for #V [GetDefine('NMercenary', 'BASE_HIRE_MONTHS')] months#!."

Z:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Crusader Kings III\game\localization\english	utorial_objectives_l_english.yml:70: hint_recruit_mercenaries: "Use [gold_i][gold|E] to recruit [mercenaries|E] to strengthen your [army|E]. Go to the military window and select mercenaries tab.

#help [mercenaries|E] will work for you based on a [mercenary_contract|E] for 3 years. You can extend it at any point by another 3 years by paying the same amount of gold when hiring.

Choose the type based on how much [gold|E] you have (you can go into [debt|E] to hire them, however being in debt reduces [advantage|E] and blocks [men_at_arms|E] reinforcement) and which is the best [counter|E] to [holder.GetNamePossessive] [men_at_arms|E]. You can see that in [holder.GetHerHis] character window under military strength tooltip.#!"
